name: Beacon Ping — Sitemap Indexer Notification

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ping-indexers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ping search engines and crawlers
    steps:
      - name: Ping Google
        run: curl -s "https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=https://www.ufosworldwide.com/sitemap.xml" -o /dev/null -w "Google: %{http_code}\n"

      - name: Ping Bing
        run: curl -s "https://www.bing.com/ping?sitemap=https://www.ufosworldwide.com/sitemap.xml" -o /dev/null -w "Bing: %{http_code}\n"

      - name: Ping IndexNow
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST "https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "host": "www.ufosworldwide.com",
              "key": "presignal-indexnow-key",
              "keyLocation": "https://www.ufosworldwide.com/presignal-indexnow-key.txt",
              "urlList": [
                "https://www.ufosworldwide.com/",
                "https://www.ufosworldwide.com/presignal.html",
                "https://www.ufosworldwide.com/sitemap.xml"
              ]
            }' -o /dev/null -w "IndexNow: %{http_code}\n"

      - name: Log pulse time
        run: echo "Beacon pulse sent at $(date -u)"
